name: Tuxocide
tagline: 3D FPS a war rages on in antarctica
blurb: A war rages on in antarctica between penguins and hostile aliens...
description:
A war rages on in antarctica between penguins and hostile aliens...

Tux's native home of Antarctica is being invaded by a hostile alien species!!
with one mission in mind, to harvest all of the tux pelts they possibly can!
Will you stop them, or aid them in their dastardly mission?

Mouse locks when you click on the window, press ESCAPE to unlock the mouse.

• W,A,S,D / Arrow Keys = Move

• L-SHIFT / R-CTRL = Sprint

• Left Click = Shoot

• Right Click = Iron Sights

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
